title: Kona Operator Blue

specs.eps_liner_structure: Multi-Density Segmented EPS Matrix with Integrated Cooling Channels

description: Tuned for all-terrain exploration, the Vemar Kona Operator Blue is bridges highway aerodynamic poise with high-flow off-road ventilation across highway asphalt and backcountry gravel. Its High-Performance Fiberglass Composite (HPFC) shell tips the scales at 1443g, channeling boundary-layer airflow to maintain a ~91 dB acoustic cabin profile while meeting ECE 22.06 impact standards. The interior leverages moisture-wicking antibacterial liners contoured for an Intermediate Oval fit, integrating eyeglass channels and track-proven Double D-Ring retention.

product_details.description: Dual-sport with removable peak, Pinlock visor, and anti-fog system.

sizing_fit.fit_notes: Vemar Kona Operator Blue is a dual-sport/adventure helmet designed for versatility. It typically features a multi-ventilation system for airflow and an extended rear coverage for wind protection during off-road riding. The fit may vary by specific sub-model (e.g., V1 or V2), so checking the specific size chart is recommended.

technical_analysis: Features Advanced multi-composite aerodynamic shell geometry engineered for optimal impact absorption and stability paired with Anti-scratch Class-1 optical shield with Pinlock anti-fog lens compatibility and toolless quick-release. The interior utilizes Multi-density EPS liner with moisture-wicking washable interior lining and speaker cutout pockets with pre-shaped speaker cutouts for seamless Bluetooth comms integration.
marketing_description: Experience the Vemar Kona Operator Blue: combining Global Certified craftsmanship with Anti-scratch Class-1 optical shield with Pinlock anti-fog lens compatibility and toolless quick-release and Multi-density EPS liner with moisture-wicking washable interior lining and speaker cutout pockets. Perfect for riders who demand uncompromised safety and aero-acoustic comfort.
yoast_title: Vemar Kona Operator Blue: Specs, Real-World Review & Price Guide
yoast_metadesc: In-depth review of the Vemar Kona Operator Blue. Tested shell weight, ECE/DOT safety rating, noise dB quietness, and fitment guide for Intermediate Oval heads.

introduction: Positioned in Vemar's Adventure / Dual Sport lineup, the Kona Operator Blue brings Global Premium engineering to riders seeking balance between weight, cabin acoustics, and impact protection. Designed for an Intermediate Oval fitment, it connects daily usability with certified ECE 22.06 track safety.
story:
The Vemar Kona Operator Blue represents Vemar's dedicated protective engineering, incorporating aerodynamic shell sculpting and multi-density EPS impact damping. Its High-Performance Fiberglass Composite (HPFC) shell dampens high-speed wind resonance while multi-density EPS channels absorb kinetic energy across direct and oblique impact vectors.

On the road, intake ports channel air across the scalp, keeping cabin noise around ~91 dB at 100 km/h. For riders seeking a High-Performance Fiberglass Composite (HPFC) Adventure / Dual Sport helmet tailored to an Intermediate Oval head shape, the Vemar Kona Operator Blue delivers verified safety and long-distance rider comfort.
